CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: UiPath, Inc. (NYSE: PATH) is a leader in business orchestration and automation, trusted by organizations worldwide to transform enterprise complexity into intelligent, secure operations where AI agents reason, robots act, and people lead. Built for the modern enterprise and the world's most regulated industries, UiPath integrates automation, orchestration, AI, and testing into governed, scalable workflows-unlocking innovation at the speed of business while delivering the controls and compliance enterprise leaders demand.
